analysis_cirs.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Active Clamp Flyback DC-DC Converter
* Auto-grounded net 4 due to VIN:-
* Created internal net n9 for RSN:neg -> CSN:pos
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=25 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=5e-13 n=1.05 Rs=0.02 Cjo=5e-12 Tt=5e-09 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Transformer (parametric, series-R + core loss) ---
.subckt Xfmr P1 P2 S1 S2 params: Lm=100u Ns=3.6 K=0.99 Rwp=0.5 Rws=0.1 Rcore=1e6 Cww=0
Rwp  P1  P1a {Rwp}
Rws  S1  S1a {Rws}
Lp   P1a P2  {Lm}
Ls   S1a S2  {Lm*Ns*Ns}
K1   Lp  Ls  {K}
Rcore P1a P2 {Rcore}
Cww  P1a S1a {Cww}
.ends Xfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 DC 12
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.05
VPWM_MAIN n_PWM_MAIN_int 0 PULSE(0 10 0 1e-07 1e-07 4.9e-06 1e-05)
RPWM_MAIN_drive n_PWM_MAIN_int n3 100
VPWM_AUX n_PWM_AUX_int n1 PULSE(0 10 4.5e-06 1e-07 1e-07 5.3e-06 1e-05)
RPWM_AUX_drive n_PWM_AUX_int n5 100
VSW_MAIN_SENSE n1 n_SW_MAIN_dsense 0
MSW_MAIN n_SW_MAIN_dsense n3 0 0 nmos_model
VSW_CLAMP_SENSE n2 n_SW_CLAMP_dsense 0
MSW_CLAMP n_SW_CLAMP_dsense n5 n1 n1 nmos_model
VC_CLAMP_SENSE n0 n_C_CLAMP_sense 0
LC_CLAMP_ESL n_C_CLAMP_sense n_C_CLAMP_esl 1e-10
RC_CLAMP_ESR n_C_CLAMP_esl n_C_CLAMP_esr 0.005
C_CLAMP n_C_CLAMP_esr n2 1e-07 IC=0
RC_CLAMP_LEAK n0 n2 5e+11
VT1_SENSE_PRI n0 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC n6 n_T1_s1_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n1 n_T1_s1_sense n8 Xfmr Lm=5e-05 Ns=1 K=-0.99 Rwp=0.15 Rws=0.05 Rcore=5e+06 Cww=0
RSN n1 n9 10
CSN n9 0 1e-09
R_ISO n8 0 1e+08
VD_SEC_SENSE n6 n_D_SEC_sense 0
RD_SEC_SENSE_DAMP n_D_SEC_sense n_D_SEC_damp 0.001
D_SEC n_D_SEC_damp n7 Dmodel
VCout_SENSE n7 n_Cout_sense 0
LCout_ESL n_Cout_sense n_Cout_esl 1e-10
RCout_ESR n_Cout_esl n_Cout_esr 0.01
Cout n_Cout_esr n8 0.00022 IC=0
RCout_LEAK n7 n8 3.2e+07
VR_LOAD_SENSE n7 n_R_LOAD_sense 0
LR_LOAD_PL n_R_LOAD_sense n_R_LOAD_mid 1e-08
R_LOAD n_R_LOAD_mid n8 10

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

* Transient Requirement tr_reg: Secondary output voltage regulation at 5V; verify isolation is maintained
tran 4e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let Vout_avg_diff = v(n7) - v(n8)
meas tran Vout_avg avg Vout_avg_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_avg
let Vout_ripple_vpp_diff = v(n7) - v(n8)
meas tran Vout_ripple_vpp pp Vout_ripple_vpp_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_ripple_vpp
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iout_avg
let VIN = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VIN.csv v(n0)
let VOUT_csv_diff = v(n7) - v(n8)
let VOUT = VOUT_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_reg_VOUT.csv VOUT_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM_MAIN.csv v(n3)
let PWM_AUX_gate_diff = v(n5) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM_AUX.csv PWM_AUX_gate_diff
let v_SW_MAIN_auto = v(n1)
wrdata time_series/V_SW_MAIN.csv v_SW_MAIN_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW_MAIN.csv i(VSW_MAIN_SENSE)
let v_SW_MAIN_gate_auto = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW_MAIN.csv v_SW_MAIN_gate_auto
let v_SW_CLAMP_auto = v(n2) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/V_SW_CLAMP.csv v_SW_CLAMP_auto
wrdata time_series/I_SW_CLAMP.csv i(VSW_CLAMP_SENSE)
let v_SW_CLAMP_gate_auto = v(n5) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/Gate_SW_CLAMP.csv v_SW_CLAMP_gate_auto
let v_C_CLAMP_auto = v(n0) - v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_C_CLAMP.csv v_C_CLAMP_auto
wrdata time_series/I_C_CLAMP.csv i(VC_CLAMP_SENSE)
let v_T1_auto = v(n0) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/V_T1.csv v_T1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_T1_pri.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI)
wrdata time_series/I_T1_sec.csv i(VT1_SENSE_SEC)
wrdata time_series/I_T1.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI)
let v_D_SEC_auto = v(n6) - v(n7)
wrdata time_series/V_D_SEC.csv v_D_SEC_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D_SEC.csv i(VD_SEC_SENSE)
let v_Cout_auto = v(n7) - v(n8)
wrdata time_series/V_Cout.csv v_Cout_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Cout.csv i(VCout_SENSE)
let v_R_LOAD_auto = v(n7) - v(n8)
wrdata time_series/V_R_LOAD.csv v_R_LOAD_auto
wrdata time_series/I_R_LOAD.csv i(VR_LOAD_SENSE)
plot v(n0) title 'tr_reg_VIN'
plot VOUT_csv_diff title 'tr_reg_VOUT'
plot v(n3) title 'Gate_PWM_MAIN'
plot PWM_AUX_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM_AUX'
plot v_SW_MAIN_auto title 'V_SW_MAIN'
plot i(VSW_MAIN_SENSE) title 'I_SW_MAIN'
plot v_SW_MAIN_gate_auto title 'Gate_SW_MAIN'
plot v_SW_CLAMP_auto title 'V_SW_CLAMP'

plot v_C_CLAMP_auto title 'V_C_CLAMP'

plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_T1_pri'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_SEC) title 'I_T1_sec'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI) title 'I_T1'

plot i(VCout_SENSE) title 'I_Cout'
plot v_R_LOAD_auto title 'V_R_LOAD'

* Transient Requirement tr_eff: Efficiency with clamp energy recycling; compare clamp capacitor voltage to estimate recycled power
tran 4e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
meas tran Iin_avg avg i(vin) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iin_avg
meas tran Iout_avg avg i(vr_load_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Iout_avg
let Vout_avg_diff = v(n7) - v(n8)
meas tran Vout_avg avg Vout_avg_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vout_avg
meas tran Vin_avg avg v(n0) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vin_avg
let Vclamp_avg_diff = v(n_C_CLAMP_esr) - v(n2)
meas tran Vclamp_avg avg Vclamp_avg_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vclamp_avg
let VCLAMP_csv_diff = v(n_C_CLAMP_esr) - v(n2)
let VCLAMP = VCLAMP_csv_diff

wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM_MAIN.csv v(n3)

wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM_AUX.csv PWM_AUX_gate_diff
plot VCLAMP_csv_diff title 'tr_eff_VCLAMP'
plot v(n3) title 'Gate_PWM_MAIN'
plot PWM_AUX_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM_AUX'

* Transient Requirement tr_stress: SW_MAIN peak voltage stress; active clamp should limit Vds_max to VIN + Vclamp
tran 4e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
meas tran Vsw_main_max max v(n1) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Vsw_main_max
meas tran Isw_main_peak max i(vsw_main_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_main_peak
meas tran Isw_main_rms rms i(vsw_main_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Isw_main_rms
meas tran Id_sec_peak max i(vd_sec_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print Id_sec_peak
let VSW_MAIN = v(n1)
wrdata time_series/tr_stress_VSW_MAIN.csv v(n1)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM_MAIN.csv v(n3)
let PWM_AUX_gate_diff = v(n5) - v(n1)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM_AUX.csv PWM_AUX_gate_diff
plot v(n1) title 'tr_stress_VSW_MAIN'
plot v(n3) title 'Gate_PWM_MAIN'
plot PWM_AUX_gate_diff title 'Gate_PWM_AUX'
.endc
